mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_receipts (payment_id, receipt_no, issued_by) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{receiptNo}, #{issuedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT pr.receipt_id, pr.receipt_no, pr.status_code, pr.issued_at, iu.name AS issued_by_name, pr.cancelled_at, pr.cancel_reason, fp.payment_id, fp.paid_amount, fp.paid_at, fp.payment_method, f.fee_id, f.billing_month, su.name AS student_name, s.student_no, c.class_name FROM payment_receipts pr JOIN fee_payments fp ON fp.payment_id = pr.payment_id JOIN fees f ON f.fee_id = fp.fee_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = f.student_id JOIN users su ON su.user_id = s.user_id JOIN users iu ON iu.user_id = pr.issued_by LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = f.class_id WHERE pr.payment_id = #{paymentId}
